description:
"Transform into an imposing beast, fearing nearby enemies for |cffffff3|r seconds. 

You also gain Major Protection, |cffffff15|r% increased Block Mitigation, and you and group members gain Minor Courage.

You summon two direwolves that deal |cffffff315|r Physical Damage twice or |cffffff1686|r Physical Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

While transformed in combat, abilities generate Fury. When you have |cffffff1000|r, this ability becomes Enduring Rampage, which gains |cffffff4000|r Health Recovery in addition to its base effects.

While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by |cffffff15|r%."
